headline: See your new website before you pay a cent.
subhead: Enter your website. We audit it automatically and build a free preview of your new site. If you like it, publish it online for one fixed price. No calls, no quotes, no sales pitch.
taxNote: Prices in Canadian dollars, plus applicable tax.

steps.title: Enter your website
steps.text: Type your business website and email. That's the whole sign-up.

steps.title: Automatic audit
steps.text: We check your current site: booking path, prices, mobile speed, contact details. Facts only, from what the check actually measured.

steps.title: Free preview
steps.text: You get a link to a preview of your new site, built from your real services, hours, address and phone. It's labelled a preview until you publish it.

steps.title: Publish online
steps.text: Like it? Pay the fixed price online and we publish it. Domain steps are sent to you by email.

steps.title: Support by email
steps.text: Questions and changes go by email. Automated replies say they're automated. Nobody will ask you to get on a call.

plans.name: Audit + preview
plans.text: See your new site before you pay. No card needed.

plans.name: Publish the site
plans.text: We take your preview live and email you the domain steps. You own the site.

plans.name: Care (optional)
plans.text: Hosting, upkeep and changes by email. Cancel anytime from your billing email.

checkoutNote: Online checkout opens soon. Start with your free preview below; when checkout is ready, the payment link appears on your preview page.
changesRule: The price on the page is the price. Any change after purchase is priced on the page or by email before it's done, never after.

trust.text: The site, the domain and the content are registered to your business and exportable any time.
No quotes, no calls, no surprise invoices.
Any automated reply or chat tells you it's automated.
We don't pool, sell or share your customers' data.
Nothing is shown as your live site until you publish it.
Everything happens on this site and by email.
